title: Justification by Faith – Romans
reason: This is a theological exposition or doctrine, not a bounded narrative story with a beginning, development, and end. The argument in Romans regarding justification by faith is a central theological theme, but it does not fit the 'biblical story' format. Epistolary literature of this type lacks narrative structure.

title: Solomon's Song of Songs – The Bride and the Groom
reason: Song of Songs chapters 1–2 do not constitute a bounded narrative story with a beginning, development, and end, but are rather a collection of poetic dialogues and love songs. Limiting it to chapters 1–2 is arbitrary—the same type of alternating song continues throughout the entire book. This does not fit into a collection of biblical stories. A previous revision pointed out the same issue.
